name: Christina
source:
“I shall extinguish your evil soul myself.”

The third princess of the Holy Kingdom of Almenan, she is also a swordswoman who has been granted the title of Hero.

Her talent with the sword blossomed from a very young age, and unlike her two older sisters, she lacks the refinement typically associated with a princess.

Strongly driven by a sense of duty and justice, she has sworn in her heart that she herself will defeat the demon race and lead the world to peace.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/sr/sien/]the official website[/url].]
